description: NOAA Climate Prediction Center Oceanic Nino Index (ONI): 3-month running anomaly of sea surface temperature in the Nino 3.4 region, by season, plus a label (El Nino at +0.5 or higher, La Nina at -0.5 or lower, otherwise neutral). Official NOAA CPC threshold; the file is updated monthly. Choose this tool for: NOAA Climate Prediction Center Oceanic Nino Index: 3-month. Close alternatives on this server: energy_climate_action_reserve (Carbon offset projects registered with the Climate Action); energy_fao_food_price_index (FAO Food Price Index monthly values from the FAO CSV). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
